I'd like each functional counsel to state any legal condition that must be included in the launch packet before I sign off. The packet currently uses our standard software, privacy, product-description, and enterprise-contract templates. Please identify any specific condition or addition you believe is required — and if you have no concerns, say so explicitly so we have it on the record. Who would like to start?

Under our company's approved proprietary deployment policy, M-17 must be replaced before any external customer access is granted. I have not yet added this finding to the launch packet, so this needs to be documented as a blocking legal condition — M-17 must be replaced with a non-AGPL alternative prior to the October 1 external launch.

The standard privacy template does not currently include these specific restrictions, so the privacy language in the launch packet must be updated to incorporate the no-training-on-customer-content provision and the exact 30-day deletion requirement before the October 1 external launch. This is a blocking legal condition.
